privacy.to: IRG Media receives the information you submit to understand your request and respond. Project enquiries include your name, work email, company and project context, with optional timing. The resource enquiry form asks for your name and work email. Please leave sensitive personal information out of these forms. This site uses Cloudflare hosting, Framer site components and analytics, and Make to route enquiries. Discovery-call bookings are handled by Calendly. These services process information under their respective privacy terms. For questions about your information, or to request access, correction or deletion, contact hello@irgmedia.org.
